annotation.method: Codex extracted and read all eleven pages in physical order, covering Sections 1-5, every theorem and proof, the barycentric-weight derivation, all numerical examples, conclusions, and all 23 references; separated cited interpolation formulas from the paper's own results; audited Mathlib and the exact frozen 44-object NumStability surface; and compiled exact private N/L proofs before retaining P57-T3.
annotation.reason: The project owner assigned the P57 source selection and benchmark annotation to Codex.

corpus_membership: This paper is part of the current corpus listed in metadata/manifest.json.

rejected_candidates.reason: Its error proof invokes the cited Newton interpolation error formula and standard divided-difference derivative bounds. The frozen library supplies no qualifying shortcut, while treating those cited results as assumptions leaves less self-contained new work than Theorem 1's denominator argument.
Its d=0 approximation estimate likewise depends on cited interpolation background and does not receive a NumStability shortcut.
The section starts from a cited general barycentric representation and derives useful formulas, but the selected denominator-positivity proof is the stronger self-contained T3 candidate.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Section 5 numerical examples and stability comments
rejected_candidates.reason: The examples are empirical, and the paper explicitly says numerical stability still has to be verified, so no exact stability task can be extracted faithfully.

T1.decision: Skipped. No internally proved P57 result needs one substantial non-Mathlib declaration from the frozen library. Nearby sign lemmas are generic and do not materially shorten the product recurrence and two-tail argument.

T2.decision: Skipped. No exact source-proved result receives two distinct substantial NumStability shortcuts; the library contains no rational-interpolation or alternating-denominator theory.

T3.decision: Selected the d>=1 interior-interval part of Theorem 1's denominator-positivity proof, including the positive middle block and both alternating decreasing tails. Exact N/L proofs establish substantial indexed work with no NumStability shortcut.

selection_policy: Use only statements and proof content present in P57.
Treat the d=0 no-poles result credited to Berrut and the cited interpolation formulas as background rather than P57 proof obligations.
Represent Theorem 1 by its self-contained d>=1 interior-interval argument without adding a stability claim that the paper leaves open.
Assign a tier only after exact private N and L proofs compile.
